WITH toy_sales AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_date,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS sales
    FROM
        orders o
        JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN product_category_name_translation t
            ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
    WHERE
        t.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY
        DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
-- Assign each date an index
dated_sales AS (
    SELECT
        order_date,
        sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_date) AS idx
    FROM toy_sales
),
-- Calculate regression coefficients
stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS n,
        SUM(idx) AS sum_x,
        SUM(CAST(strftime('%s', order_date) AS INTEGER) / 86400.0) AS sum_date,
        SUM(sales) AS sum_y,
        SUM(idx * sales) AS sum_xy,
        SUM(idx * idx) AS sum_xx
    FROM dated_sales
),
-- Compute regression beta and alpha
regression AS (
    SELECT
        (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / (n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x) AS beta,
        (sum_y * 1.0 / n) - ((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) * 1.0 / (n * sum_xx - sum_x * sum_x)) * (sum_x * 1.0 / n) AS alpha,
        (SELECT MAX(idx) FROM dated_sales) AS max_idx,
        (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM dated_sales) AS last_date
    FROM stats
),
-- Predict daily sales for Dec 1~12, 2018 using regression
future_dates AS (
    -- We want all days so moving average centered on Dec 5-8 can be calculated
    SELECT
        DATE('2018-12-01', '+' || (n - 1) || ' days') AS pred_date,
        n
    FROM (
        SELECT 1 AS n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5
        UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10
        UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12
    )
),
future_idx AS (
    -- Index: max_idx + days since last_date
    SELECT
        f.pred_date,
        r.alpha + r.beta * (r.max_idx + CAST(julianday(f.pred_date) - julianday(r.last_date) AS INTEGER)) AS pred_sales
    FROM
        future_dates f
        CROSS JOIN regression r
),
-- Calculate symmetric 5-day moving averages for Dec 5-8, 2018
moving_avg AS (
    SELECT
        f1.pred_date,
        AVG(f2.pred_sales) AS ma_5d
    FROM
        future_idx f1
        JOIN future_idx f2
            ON julianday(f2.pred_date) BETWEEN julianday(f1.pred_date, '-2 days') AND julianday(f1.pred_date, '+2 days')
    WHERE
        f1.pred_date BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08'
    GROUP BY
        f1.pred_date
)
SELECT SUM(ma_5d) AS sum_5day_moving_avg_dec5_to_dec8
FROM moving_avg;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_spend_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         o.order_id,
         MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_purchase_timestamp,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS order_total
    FROM customers c
    JOIN delivered_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
   GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id, o.order_id
),
rfm_raw AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_unique_id,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase,
    COUNT(order_id) AS freq,
    SUM(order_total) AS monetary
  FROM customer_spend_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
recency_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY last_purchase DESC) AS r
  FROM rfm_raw
),
frequency_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY freq DESC) AS f
  FROM recency_ranked
),
monetary_ranked AS (
  SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS m
  FROM frequency_ranked
),
rfm_segmented AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id,
         r, f, m,
         (f + m) AS fm_sum,
         CASE 
           WHEN r = 1 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
           WHEN r IN (4,5) AND (f + m) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN "Can't Lose Them"
           WHEN r IN (4,5) AND (f + m) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
           WHEN r IN (4,5) AND (f + m) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
           WHEN r IN (2,3) AND (f + m) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
           WHEN r = 3 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
           WHEN r = 1 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
           WHEN (r = 1 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (r = 2 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
           WHEN r = 1 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
           WHEN r = 2 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
           WHEN r = 3 AND (f + m) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           ELSE 'Other'
         END AS rfm_segment
  FROM monetary_ranked
),
avg_sales_per_order AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM customers c
  JOIN delivered_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
rfm_result AS (
  SELECT s.rfm_segment, s.customer_unique_id, a.total_sales, a.total_orders, 
         CASE WHEN a.total_orders > 0 THEN a.total_sales * 1.0 / a.total_orders ELSE 0 END AS avg_sales_per_order
  FROM rfm_segmented s
  JOIN avg_sales_per_order a ON a.customer_unique_id = s.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT rfm_segment, 
       COUNT(customer_unique_id) AS num_customers,
       AVG(avg_sales_per_order) AS avg_order_sales_segment
FROM rfm_result
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_order_sales_segment DESC

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_id,
    MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS first_purchase,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS last_purchase
  FROM orders o
),
customer_payments AS (
  SELECT
    co.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT co.order_id) AS num_orders,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment,
    MIN(co.first_purchase) AS first_purchase,
    MAX(co.last_purchase) AS last_purchase
  FROM customer_orders co
  JOIN order_payments op ON co.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY co.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    cp.customer_id,
    cp.num_orders,
    (1.0 * cp.total_payment) / cp.num_orders AS avg_payment_per_order,
    -- Lifespan in weeks
    CASE 
      WHEN (JULIANDAY(cp.last_purchase) - JULIANDAY(cp.first_purchase)) / 7.0 < 1.0 
        THEN 1.0
      ELSE (JULIANDAY(cp.last_purchase) - JULIANDAY(cp.first_purchase)) / 7.0 
    END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM customer_payments cp
  WHERE cp.num_orders > 0
)
SELECT
  cm.customer_id,
  cm.num_orders,
  cm.avg_payment_per_order,
  cm.lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_metrics cm
ORDER BY cm.avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH career_span_parts AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    -- Calculate date parts
    debut,
    final_game,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER) AS year_diff,
    CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER) AS month_diff,
    CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER) AS day_diff
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND final_game IS NOT NULL
),
adjusted_span AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    -- Adjust month and day differences: "borrow" from months and years as needed
    CASE 
      WHEN month_diff < 0 THEN year_diff - 1
      ELSE year_diff
    END AS adj_year,
    ROUND(
      CASE 
        WHEN month_diff < 0 THEN month_diff + 12
        ELSE month_diff
      END
    , 2) AS adj_month,
    ROUND(
      CASE 
        WHEN day_diff < 0 THEN
          -- Reduce adjusted month by 1 and add days-in-previous-month (approximate 30)
          day_diff + 30
        ELSE day_diff
      END
    , 2) AS adj_day
  FROM career_span_parts
),
career_span AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    ROUND(ABS(adj_year), 2) AS rd_year,
    ROUND(ABS(adj_month) / 12.0, 2) AS rd_month,
    ROUND(ABS(adj_day) / 365.0, 2) AS rd_day,
    ROUND(
      ROUND(ABS(adj_year), 2) + ROUND(ABS(adj_month) / 12.0, 2) + ROUND(ABS(adj_day) / 365.0, 2)
    , 6) AS career_span_yr
  FROM adjusted_span
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(career_span_yr), 6) AS avg_career_span_years
FROM career_span;

WITH motorcycle_parties AS (
  SELECT
    p.case_id,
    p.party_number,
    p.party_safety_equipment_1,
    p.party_safety_equipment_2,
    p.party_number_killed,
    -- 파티가 오토바이/스쿠터인지 확인
    (LOWER(COALESCE(p.statewide_vehicle_type, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.statewide_vehicle_type, '')) LIKE '%scooter%') AS is_motorcycle,
    -- 헬멧 착용 여부: party_safety_equipment_1 또는 _2에 "motorcycle helmet used"가 명시적으로 포함되는 경우
    (
      LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%' OR
      LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%'
    ) AS helmet_used
  FROM parties p
),
filtered_motorcycle_parties AS (
  -- 오토바이 파티만 추출
  SELECT * FROM motorcycle_parties WHERE is_motorcycle = 1
),
helmet_stats AS (
  -- 케이스별로 "헬멧 착용 또는 미착용한 오토바이 파티가 1명 이상"인 사건을 집계
  SELECT
    case_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN helmet_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_helmet,
    MAX(CASE WHEN helmet_used=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_no_helmet
  FROM filtered_motorcycle_parties
  GROUP BY case_id
),
collision_helmet_group AS (
  -- 하나의 collision(case_id)에 대하여 'helmet', 'no_helmet' 그룹을 부여
  SELECT
    case_id,
    CASE
      WHEN has_helmet = 1 AND has_no_helmet = 0 THEN 'helmet'
      WHEN has_helmet = 0 AND has_no_helmet = 1 THEN 'no_helmet'
      ELSE NULL -- 혼재시 제외(명확한 그룹만 비교)
    END AS helmet_group
  FROM helmet_stats
  WHERE (has_helmet = 1 AND has_no_helmet = 0) OR (has_helmet = 0 AND has_no_helmet = 1)
),
collision_fatalities AS (
  -- 케이스별 전체 오토바이 사망자 수 집계
  SELECT
    fmp.case_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(fmp.party_number_killed,0)) AS motorcyclist_fatalities
  FROM filtered_motorcycle_parties fmp
  GROUP BY fmp.case_id
),
final_stats AS (
  -- 그룹별로 충돌건수 및 사망자수 집계
  SELECT
    chg.helmet_group,
    COUNT(DISTINCT chg.case_id) AS collision_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(cf.motorcyclist_fatalities,0)) AS total_fatalities
  FROM collision_helmet_group chg
  LEFT JOIN collision_fatalities cf
    ON chg.case_id = cf.case_id
  GROUP BY chg.helmet_group
)
SELECT
  helmet_group AS "helmet_usage",
  total_fatalities,
  collision_count,
  ROUND(
    CASE WHEN collision_count > 0 THEN
      100.0 * total_fatalities / collision_count
    ELSE NULL END, 2
  ) AS fatality_rate_percent
FROM final_stats
ORDER BY helmet_group;

WITH yearly_top_causes AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    primary_collision_factor,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY strftime('%Y', collision_date) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, primary_collision_factor
),
year_and_top_two AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    primary_collision_factor,
    rn
  FROM yearly_top_causes
  WHERE rn <= 2
),
cause_sets AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    GROUP_CONCAT(primary_collision_factor, ',') AS top2_causes
  FROM year_and_top_two
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT year
FROM cause_sets
WHERE top2_causes NOT IN (
  SELECT top2_causes
  FROM cause_sets
  GROUP BY top2_causes
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

WITH year_category_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    pcf_violation_category,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM collisions
  WHERE year IN ('2011', '2021')
  GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
),
most_common_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category
  FROM year_category_counts
  WHERE year = '2021'
  ORDER BY count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
category_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ycc.year,
    ycc.count * 1.0 / y.total AS share
  FROM year_category_counts ycc
  JOIN (
    SELECT year, SUM(count) AS total
    FROM year_category_counts
    GROUP BY year
  ) y ON ycc.year = y.year
  WHERE ycc.pcf_violation_category = (SELECT pcf_violation_category FROM most_common_2021)
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT share FROM category_shares WHERE year = '2021') -
  (SELECT share FROM category_shares WHERE year = '2011') AS percentage_point_change

SELECT 
    strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2016,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2017,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2018
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    c.customer_city,
    c.customer_state,
    COUNT(*) AS num_delivered_orders
  FROM olist_orders o
  JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_city, c.customer_state
),
top_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    customer_city,
    customer_state,
    num_delivered_orders
  FROM delivered_orders
  ORDER BY num_delivered_orders DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT
  tc.customer_unique_id,
  tc.customer_city,
  tc.customer_state,
  do.num_delivered_orders,
  AVG(oi_total.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
FROM top_customers tc
JOIN delivered_orders do
  ON tc.customer_unique_id = do.customer_unique_id
JOIN olist_orders o
  ON do.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value
  FROM olist_order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
) oi_total ON o.order_id = oi_total.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY tc.customer_unique_id, tc.customer_city, tc.customer_state, do.num_delivered_orders
ORDER BY do.num_delivered_orders DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_city
  FROM
    olist_orders o
    JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
city_payments AS (
  SELECT
    do.customer_city,
    SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT do.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
  FROM
    delivered_orders do
    JOIN olist_order_payments op ON do.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY
    do.customer_city
),
lowest5 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_city,
    total_payments,
    delivered_order_count
  FROM
    city_payments
  ORDER BY
    total_payments ASC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_payments) AS avg_total_payments,
  AVG(delivered_order_count) AS avg_delivered_order_count
FROM
  lowest5;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) AS year,
    strftime('%Y-%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS year_month
  FROM olist_orders
  WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
),
annual_volumes AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    COUNT(*) AS annual_delivered_orders
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY year
),
lowest_year AS (
  SELECT year
  FROM annual_volumes
  ORDER BY annual_delivered_orders ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_volumes AS (
  SELECT
    year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_delivered_orders
  FROM delivered_orders
  WHERE year = (SELECT year FROM lowest_year)
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  MAX(monthly_delivered_orders) AS highest_monthly_delivered_orders_in_lowest_year
FROM monthly_volumes;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id 
    FROM olist_orders 
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_items_delivered AS (
    SELECT oi.*, o.customer_id
    FROM olist_order_items oi
    JOIN delivered_orders d ON oi.order_id = d.order_id
    JOIN olist_orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
),
seller_distinct_customers AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers
    FROM order_items_delivered
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_profit AS (
    SELECT seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) AS profit
    FROM order_items_delivered
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_orders
    FROM order_items_delivered
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
order_reviews_5star AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
),
seller_5star_reviews AS (
    SELECT oid.seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT oid.order_id) AS five_star_reviews
    FROM order_items_delivered oid
    JOIN order_reviews_5star r ON oid.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY oid.seller_id
),
top_seller_distinct_customers AS (
    SELECT seller_id, distinct_customers, 
           'Highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement
    FROM seller_distinct_customers
    WHERE distinct_customers = (SELECT MAX(distinct_customers) FROM seller_distinct_customers)
    LIMIT 1
),
top_seller_profit AS (
    SELECT seller_id, profit,
           'Highest profit (price - freight value)' AS achievement
    FROM seller_profit
    WHERE profit = (SELECT MAX(profit) FROM seller_profit)
    LIMIT 1
),
top_seller_distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT seller_id, distinct_orders,
           'Highest number of distinct orders' AS achievement
    FROM seller_distinct_orders
    WHERE distinct_orders = (SELECT MAX(distinct_orders) FROM seller_distinct_orders)
    LIMIT 1
),
top_seller_5star_reviews AS (
    SELECT seller_id, five_star_reviews,
           'Most 5-star ratings' AS achievement
    FROM seller_5star_reviews
    WHERE five_star_reviews = (SELECT MAX(five_star_reviews) FROM seller_5star_reviews)
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT seller_id, distinct_customers AS value, achievement
FROM top_seller_distinct_customers
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id, profit AS value, achievement
FROM top_seller_profit
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id, distinct_orders AS value, achievement
FROM top_seller_distinct_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT seller_id, five_star_reviews AS value, achievement
FROM top_seller_5star_reviews;

WITH category_payment_counts AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name,
        op.payment_type,
        COUNT(*) AS num_payments
    FROM
        olist_order_items oi
        JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
        JOIN olist_order_payments op ON oi.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY
        p.product_category_name,
        op.payment_type
),
most_preferred_payments AS (
    SELECT
        category_payment_counts.product_category_name,
        category_payment_counts.payment_type,
        category_payment_counts.num_payments
    FROM
        category_payment_counts
        JOIN (
            SELECT
                product_category_name,
                MAX(num_payments) AS max_payments
            FROM
                category_payment_counts
            GROUP BY
                product_category_name
        ) max_per_category
        ON category_payment_counts.product_category_name = max_per_category.product_category_name
        AND category_payment_counts.num_payments = max_per_category.max_payments
)
SELECT
    AVG(num_payments) AS avg_num_payments_for_top_method
FROM
    most_preferred_payments;

WITH ordered_cities AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS rn
  FROM
    olist_geolocation
  GROUP BY
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city
),
city_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    c1.geolocation_state AS state1,
    c1.geolocation_city AS city1,
    c1.geolocation_lat AS lat1,
    c1.geolocation_lng AS lng1,
    c2.geolocation_state AS state2,
    c2.geolocation_city AS city2,
    c2.geolocation_lat AS lat2,
    c2.geolocation_lng AS lng2,
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat)) *
      COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lng)) +
      SIN(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM
    ordered_cities c1
    JOIN ordered_cities c2 ON c2.rn = c1.rn + 1
)
SELECT
  state1, city1, state2, city2, distance_km
FROM
  city_pairs
ORDER BY
  distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH product_category_orders AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    oi.order_id
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
),
order_payments_with_cat AS (
  SELECT
    pco.product_category_name,
    op.payment_type,
    op.payment_sequential
  FROM olist_order_payments op

category_payment_counts AS (

WITH artist_sales AS (

  JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId

),
top_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName
  FROM artist_sales
  ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
low_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName
  FROM artist_sales
  ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
target_artists AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, 'top' AS RankFlag FROM top_artist
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, 'low' AS RankFlag FROM low_artist
),
customer_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    c.CustomerId,
    ta.ArtistName,
    ta.RankFlag,
    SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
  FROM customers c

  JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN target_artists ta ON al.ArtistId = ta.ArtistId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, ta.ArtistName, ta.RankFlag
)
SELECT
  ABS(
    (SELECT AVG(AmountSpent) FROM customer_spending WHERE RankFlag = 'top')

WITH monthly_payments AS (

        customer_id,

),
monthly_changes AS (

    FROM monthly_payments
),
change_amounts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ABS(monthly_amount - prev_monthly_amount) AS abs_change
    FROM monthly_changes
    WHERE prev_monthly_amount IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        AVG(abs_change) AS avg_monthly_change
    FROM change_amounts
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name

WITH month_txn AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS year_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),
month_positive_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    year_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN customer_id END) AS pos_bal_count
  FROM month_txn
  GROUP BY year_month
),
max_min_months AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(pos_bal_count) AS max_count,
    MIN(pos_bal_count) AS min_count
  FROM month_positive_counts
),
max_month AS (
  SELECT year_month, pos_bal_count
  FROM month_positive_counts, max_min_months
  WHERE pos_bal_count = max_count
  LIMIT 1
),
min_month AS (
  SELECT year_month, pos_bal_count
  FROM month_positive_counts, max_min_months
  WHERE pos_bal_count = min_count
  LIMIT 1
),
month_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    year_month, 
    AVG(month_end_balance * 1.0) AS avg_month_end_balance
  FROM month_txn
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
  max_month.year_month AS month_with_most_positive,
  min_month.year_month AS month_with_least_positive,
  max_avg.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_in_most_positive_month,
  min_avg.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_in_least_positive_month,
  (max_avg.avg_month_end_balance - min_avg.avg_month_end_balance) AS avg_difference
FROM
  max_month
  JOIN min_month
  JOIN month_avgs AS max_avg ON max_avg.year_month = max_month.year_month
  JOIN month_avgs AS min_avg ON min_avg.year_month = min_month.year_month

WITH valid_orders AS (

  JOIN pizza_runner_orders ro ON o.order_id = ro.order_id
  WHERE ro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(ro.cancellation) = ''
),
pizza_prices AS (
  SELECT
    pizza_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 12   -- Meat Lovers
      WHEN pizza_id = 2 THEN 10   -- Vegetarian
      ELSE 0
    END AS base_price
  FROM pizza_names
),
extras_count AS (
  -- Count the number of extra toppings per order
  SELECT
    order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN extras IS NULL OR TRIM(extras) = '' THEN 0

  FROM valid_orders
)
SELECT

JOIN extras_count ec ON vo.order_id = ec.order_id;

WITH month_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(strftime('%Y', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS year,
    CAST(strftime('%m', insert_date) AS INTEGER) AS month,
    COUNT(city_id) AS cities_added
  FROM cities
  WHERE strftime('%Y', insert_date) IN ('2021','2022','2023') AND strftime('%m', insert_date) IN ('04','05','06')
  GROUP BY year, month
),
all_periods AS (
  SELECT 2021 as year, 4 as month UNION ALL
  SELECT 2021, 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2021, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022, 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022, 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2022, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023, 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023, 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT 2023, 6
),
filled_months AS (
  SELECT ap.year, ap.month, COALESCE(md.cities_added, 0) AS cities_added
  FROM all_periods ap
  LEFT JOIN month_data md ON ap.year = md.year AND ap.month = md.month
),
cum_month AS (
  SELECT
    year, month,
    cities_added,
    (SELECT SUM(cm2.cities_added) FROM filled_months cm2 WHERE cm2.month = fm.month AND cm2.year <= fm.year) AS running_total
  FROM filled_months fm
),
growths AS (
  SELECT
    year, month, cities_added, running_total,
    LAG(cities_added) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_cities_added,
    LAG(running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year) AS prev_running_total
  FROM cum_month
)
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  cities_added,
  running_total,
  CASE WHEN prev_cities_added IS NOT NULL AND prev_cities_added != 0 THEN ROUND((cities_added - prev_cities_added)*100.0/prev_cities_added,1) ELSE NULL END AS month_yoy_growth_pct,
  CASE WHEN prev_running_total IS NOT NULL AND prev_running_total != 0 THEN ROUND((running_total - prev_running_total)*100.0/prev_running_total,1) ELSE NULL END AS cumulative_yoy_growth_pct
FROM growths
WHERE year IN (2022, 2023)
ORDER BY year, month

WITH first_payment AS (

),
customer_ltv AS (

avg_values AS (

first_film_per_customer AS (

first_film_rating_per_customer AS (

customer_total_payments AS (

customer_total_rentals AS (

per_customer_stats AS (

month_diffs AS (

    GROUP BY s.hub_id, o.order_created_year, o.order_created_month
),
month_compare AS (

    JOIN finished_orders f2

)
SELECT

WITH TeamSeasonGoals AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_api_id,
    strftime('%Y', m.date) AS season,
    SUM(
      CASE 
        WHEN t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal
        WHEN t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS total_goals
  FROM Team t
  JOIN Match m
    ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_api_id, strftime('%Y', m.date)
),
TeamMaxSeasonGoals AS (
  SELECT
    team_api_id,
    MAX(total_goals) AS max_season_goals
  FROM TeamSeasonGoals
  GROUP BY team_api_id
),
OrderedGoals AS (
  SELECT
    max_season_goals,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_season_goals) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM TeamMaxSeasonGoals
)
SELECT
  AVG(max_season_goals) AS median_of_highest_season_goals
FROM OrderedGoals
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);

WITH all_wins AS (
  SELECT
    m.league_id,
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM Match m
  GROUP BY m.league_id, m.home_team_api_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.league_id,
    m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM Match m
  GROUP BY m.league_id, m.away_team_api_id
),
team_league_combos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.id AS league_id, t.team_api_id
  FROM League l CROSS JOIN Team t
),
total_wins AS (
  SELECT
    c.league_id,
    c.team_api_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(aw.wins), 0) AS total_wins
  FROM team_league_combos c
  LEFT JOIN all_wins aw

),
ranked_wins AS (

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tw.league_id ORDER BY tw.total_wins ASC, tw.team_api_id) AS rn

WITH
-- Basic stats for duration in milliseconds
dur_stats AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(Milliseconds) AS min_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) AS max_ms
  FROM Track
),
-- Midpoints per definition
length_midpoints AS (
  SELECT
    min_ms,
    avg_ms,
    max_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 AS mid1,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 AS mid2
  FROM dur_stats
),
-- Classify each track into category
track_category AS (
  SELECT
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    CASE
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >= mp.min_ms AND t.Milliseconds < mp.mid1 THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >= mp.mid1 AND t.Milliseconds < mp.mid2 THEN 'Medium'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds >= mp.mid2 AND t.Milliseconds <= mp.max_ms THEN 'Long'
      ELSE 'Unclassified'
    END AS category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN length_midpoints mp
),
-- Map InvoiceLines to track categories
il_with_cat AS (
  SELECT
    il.InvoiceLineId,
    il.UnitPrice,
    il.Quantity,
    tc.category,
    tc.Milliseconds
  FROM InvoiceLine il
  JOIN track_category tc ON il.TrackId = tc.TrackId
),
-- Calculate min/max duration (in min), total revenue per category
agg AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    MIN(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS min_duration_min,
    MAX(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS max_duration_min,
    SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity) AS total_revenue
  FROM il_with_cat
  WHERE category != 'Unclassified'
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
  category,
  ROUND(min_duration_min,2) AS min_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(max_duration_min,2) AS max_duration_minutes,
  ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue
FROM agg
ORDER BY category

WITH match_points AS (
  SELECT
    M.season,
    L.name AS league_name,
    C.name AS country_name,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS winner_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      WHEN M.home_team_goal < M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS loser_team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.home_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS tie_team1_id,
    CASE
      WHEN M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal THEN M.away_team_api_id
      ELSE NULL
    END AS tie_team2_id
  FROM Match M
  JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
  JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
),
points_by_team AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    winner_team_id AS team_id,
    3 AS points
  FROM match_points
  WHERE winner_team_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    tie_team1_id AS team_id,
    1 AS points
  FROM match_points
  WHERE tie_team1_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    tie_team2_id AS team_id,
    1 AS points
  FROM match_points
  WHERE tie_team2_id IS NOT NULL
),
season_team_points AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    team_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM points_by_team
  GROUP BY season, league_name, country_name, team_id
),
champion_by_season AS (
  SELECT
    stp.season,
    stp.league_name,
    stp.country_name,
    stp.team_id,
    stp.total_points,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY stp.country_name, stp.league_name, stp.season
      ORDER BY stp.total_points DESC, stp.team_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM season_team_points stp
)
SELECT
  cbs.season,
  cbs.country_name,
  cbs.league_name,
  T.team_long_name AS champion_team_name,
  cbs.total_points
FROM champion_by_season cbs
JOIN Team T ON cbs.team_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE cbs.rn = 1
ORDER BY cbs.country_name, cbs.league_name, cbs.season;

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate, 
    SQRT(AVG(("loss_rate_%" - (SELECT AVG("loss_rate_%") FROM veg_loss_rate_df)) * ("loss_rate_%" - (SELECT AVG("loss_rate_%") FROM veg_loss_rate_df)))) AS std_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    item_code,
    item_name,
    "loss_rate_%",
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS avg_loss_rate,
    (SELECT std_loss_rate FROM stats) AS std_loss_rate,
    CASE 
      WHEN "loss_rate_%" < (SELECT avg_loss_rate - std_loss_rate FROM stats) THEN 'below one std dev'
      WHEN "loss_rate_%" > (SELECT avg_loss_rate + std_loss_rate FROM stats) THEN 'above one std dev'
      ELSE 'within one std dev'
    END AS deviation_category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS avg_loss_rate,
  (SELECT std_loss_rate FROM stats) AS std_loss_rate,
  SUM(deviation_category = 'below one std dev') AS count_below_one_stddev,
  SUM(deviation_category = 'within one std dev') AS count_within_one_stddev,
  SUM(deviation_category = 'above one std dev') AS count_above_one_stddev
FROM classified;

WITH seller_sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        SUM(oi.product_id IS NOT NULL) AS total_sales, -- total items sold
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_avg_review AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(CAST(orv.review_score AS FLOAT)) AS avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing_time AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            JULIANDAY(o.order_approved_at) - JULIANDAY(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
        ) * 24 AS avg_packing_time_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.seller_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        COUNT(*) AS category_sales
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, p.product_category_name
),
category_max_sales AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        product_category_name,
        category_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY seller_id ORDER BY category_sales DESC) as rn
    FROM seller_category_sales
)
SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    ss.total_sales,
    ROUND(ss.avg_item_price,2) AS avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sar.avg_review_score,2) AS avg_review_score,
    ROUND(spt.avg_packing_time_hours,2) AS avg_packing_time_hours,
    pct.product_category_name_english AS top_category_name,
    cms.category_sales AS top_category_sales
FROM sellers s
JOIN seller_sales ss ON s.seller_id = ss.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_avg_review sar ON s.seller_id = sar.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing_time spt ON s.seller_id = spt.seller_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        cms.seller_id,
        cms.product_category_name,
        cms.category_sales
    FROM category_max_sales cms
    WHERE cms.rn = 1
) cms ON s.seller_id = cms.seller_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON cms.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE ss.total_sales > 100
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC

WITH date_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(date(txn_date)) AS min_date,
    MAX(date(txn_date)) AS max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date(min_date, '+' || n || ' days') as the_date
  FROM date_bounds, 
       (SELECT 0 as n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23 UNION ALL SELECT 24 UNION ALL SELECT 25 UNION ALL SELECT 26 UNION ALL SELECT 27 UNION ALL SELECT 28 UNION ALL SELECT 29 UNION ALL SELECT 30 UNION ALL SELECT 31 UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49) nums
  WHERE date(min_date, '+' || n || ' days') <= max_date
),
per_day_trans AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date(txn_date) as the_date, SUM(txn_amount) as day_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, the_date
),
joined_dates AS (
  SELECT d.customer_id, d.the_date, COALESCE(t.day_amount, 0) as day_amount
  FROM all_dates d
  LEFT JOIN per_day_trans t ON d.customer_id = t.customer_id AND d.the_date = t.the_date
),
customer_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    the_date,
    MAX(SUM(day_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY the_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) as balance
  FROM joined_dates
),
customer_balances_nonneg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, the_date, CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END as balance
  FROM customer_balances
),
max_daily_balance_per_month AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', the_date) as year_month,
    MAX(balance) as max_balance
  FROM customer_balances_nonneg
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  SUM(max_balance) as total_max_daily_balance
FROM max_daily_balance_per_month
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

WITH june_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', week_date) AS year,
    week_date,
    ABS(julianday(week_date) - julianday(strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15')) AS diff_from_june15
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE strftime('%Y', week_date) IN ('2018', '2019', '2020')
),
periods AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.*, 
    jd.year,
    CASE 
      WHEN ws.week_date < jd2.june15 THEN 'before'
      ELSE 'after' 
    END AS period
  FROM weekly_sales ws
  JOIN (
    SELECT year, MIN(date) as june15
    FROM (
      SELECT strftime('%Y', week_date) as year, strftime('%Y', week_date) || '-06-15' as date 
      FROM weekly_sales 
      WHERE strftime('%Y', week_date) IN ('2018', '2019', '2020')
      GROUP BY year
    )
    GROUP BY year
  ) jd2 ON strftime('%Y', ws.week_date) = jd2.year
  JOIN june_dates jd ON ws.week_date = jd.week_date AND jd.year = jd2.year
  WHERE jd.diff_from_june15 <= 27 -- within 4 weeks (4*7-1)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, period ORDER BY ABS(julianday(week_date) - julianday(year || '-06-15'))) as rn
  FROM periods
)
SELECT 
  year,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN sales END)*1.0, 2) AS sales_before,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN sales END)*1.0, 2) AS sales_after,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN sales END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN sales END), 0), 2) AS percent_change
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 4
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH sales_periods AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    age_band,
    demographic,
    customer_type,
    CASE
      WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' AND week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-12 week') THEN 'pre'
      WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+12 week') THEN 'post'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS period,
    sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE
    week_date >= date('2020-06-15', '-12 week')
    AND week_date < date('2020-06-15', '+12 week')
),
agg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    age_band,
    demographic,
    customer_type,
    period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_periods
  WHERE period IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type, period
),
pct_change AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    platform,
    age_band,
    demographic,
    customer_type,
    CASE
      WHEN pre_sales > 0 THEN 100.0 * (post_sales - pre_sales) / pre_sales
      ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_change
  FROM (
    SELECT
      a.region, a.platform, a.age_band, a.demographic, a.customer_type,
      a.total_sales AS pre_sales,
      b.total_sales AS post_sales
    FROM agg_sales a
    JOIN agg_sales b
      ON a.region = b.region
      AND a.platform = b.platform
      AND a.age_band = b.age_band
      AND a.demographic = b.demographic
      AND a.customer_type = b.customer_type
    WHERE a.period = 'pre' AND b.period = 'post'
  )
),
attr_type_avg AS (
  SELECT 'region' AS attr_type, AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change FROM pct_change GROUP BY region
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM pct_change GROUP BY platform
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM pct_change GROUP BY age_band
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM pct_change GROUP BY demographic
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM pct_change GROUP BY customer_type
),
final_avg AS (
  SELECT attr_type, AVG(avg_pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
  FROM attr_type_avg
  GROUP BY attr_type
)
SELECT
  attr_type,
  avg_pct_change
FROM final_avg
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH ordered_logs AS (
  SELECT 
    session, 
    user_id, 
    action, 
    stamp, 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS rn
  FROM access_log
),
page_triples AS (
  SELECT 
    l1.session, 
    l1.user_id, 
    l1.stamp AS stamp1, 
    l2.stamp AS stamp2, 
    l3.stamp AS stamp3,
    l1.action AS action1, 
    l2.action AS action2, 
    l3.action AS action3
  FROM ordered_logs l1
  JOIN ordered_logs l2 ON l1.session = l2.session AND l1.rn + 1 = l2.rn
  JOIN ordered_logs l3 ON l1.session = l3.session AND l1.rn + 2 = l3.rn
)
SELECT 
  action3 AS third_page_visit, 
  COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM page_triples
WHERE action1 = '/detail' AND action2 = '/detail' AND action3 != '/detail'
GROUP BY action3
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 3;
